Windows, h9kd runs on a desktop of its own in WinSta0 that is created for it and never switched to: WindowsDaemonLaunch.Create, which both h9k daemon start and the logon autostart task use, creates the desktop and starts h9kd on it through STARTUPINFO.lpDesktop with a new console whose window is visible on that desktop (CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE in place of CREATE_NO_WINDOW), so every process h9kd starts inherits both. macOS and Linux behaviour is unchanged.\u0022,\u0022On this node, with a Remote Desktop session to it connected, a kernel pool trace of at least 30 seconds under h9kd\\u0027s normal load, taken with docs/spikes/windows-token-leak-origin/analysis/toke-nostacks.wprp and attributed with the TokeTrace tool in the same folder, shows 0 tokens never freed for every process in h9kd\\u0027s tree; and the node-wide live token count read with the node\\u0027s toke-count.ps1 rises by under 0.5 a second over one hour with the session still connected (node-wide, so a miss is read against the per-tree trace).\u0022,\u0022A headless agent session and a verification gate started by h9kd on this node complete with their output captured as before, no window from either appears on the visible desktop, and h9k daemon status, h9k daemon stop and the logon autostart task still find and stop h9kd.\u0022,\u0022With Git Credential Manager as the configured credential helper and no stored credential, a git call h9kd makes to a remote it holds no token for ends with a failure within two minutes whose message names the credential helper, and leaves no process it started running.\u0022,\u0022No operating system or user setting is changed to achieve this.\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022Fix for the Windows token leak that remains after #862 and #866. Cause (probe 6469becc, 2026-11-12; evidence in the project home\\u0027s notes/leak-manager/post-reboot-cause.md and idea 6eec0600\\u0027s workspace journal): h9kd\\u0027s git children keep kernel access tokens, about 4 to 6 a second, only while all three hold: a Remote Desktop session to the node is connected, the launcher is outside the focused app\\u0027s process tree, and the child\\u0027s console is on the visible desktop. With the session disconnected the rate is flat. Spike 0b4685d2 measured 0 kept for git, gh, sh, bash and the agent CLI only when the root process sits on a private desktop with its own visible console (its tF arm and start-mode matrix); a windowless or hidden console on a private desktop still kept tokens (tA arm 0, including git to git-core rows). Its findings are not on main: read docs/spikes/h9kd-detached-console/FINDINGS.md on branch origin/task/0b4685d2-find-whether-hall9k-can-stop-t (commit b67fd73d). Design: change only WindowsDaemonLaunch.Create (src/Hall9k.Cli/DaemonControl/WindowsDaemonLaunch.cs, CreateProcessW at about line 258, StartupInfo Desktop field at about 339 to 343), reached from DaemonLifecycle.StartDetached and DaemonAutostartLaunchCommand.RunUntilExitAsync; no child start site is rewritten. If this fails criterion 2, the fallback is a new visible console per child on the private desktop, not lpDesktop on an inherited console. Known open risks, not in scope: a child showing UI on the private desktop waits unseen; CreateNoWindow children (WindowsProcessManager.cs:26) each draw on that desktop\\u0027s
